Element.Name: prepare_sit
Element.attribute: Plan for system integration testing (SIT) cycles 1 through n based on the test strategy and design the test scenarios, cases and scripts as well as the data requirements for conducting the tests.

Element.Name: Design Tests
Element.attribute: In this activity, how test are performed are defined at granular level. Effective test design typically requires knowledge of the target solution, knowledge of the functionality under test, and test techniques employed. An efficient test design does not include redundant test scripts.
